ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels covering approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and sparse focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region spanning both lobes. High-contrast contiguous white blobs are located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Sparse, small-scale white focal spots are distributed in the lower-central and right-central quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with a calculated wide interior angle of approximately 135 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with varying pixel-amplitude peaks along the outer trailing edges; topography becomes notably smoother and lower in amplitude as the contour approaches the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory along the trailing edge segments meeting at the notch; the leading edge (bottom boundary) displays a convex upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) localized exclusively on the distal tips and outer edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, distinct linear pixel disruptions (white rake marks) visible on the right lobe surface, specifically one horizontal disruption in the upper-right quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on the distal tips; visible linear scratches on the right lobe surface.
